title: Live relay down
blurb: The live relay doesn't answer: the page says it shows the last build.
description: data/config.json names a live relay that can't be reached (a .invalid host). The page runs its normal live path (site/testmode.js LIVE_PATH) and must say "Live data unavailable — showing data from N min ago". DEN has a High Wind Warning so there is something to show.
